about_the_game:
Do you dare to ignite the last spark of hope in a world consumed by shadows?

In Little Lights Remains, by Another Path Studios, you’ll dive into a unique experience that blends adventure and Tower Defense. Step into the role of the Guardian of Light, an ancient creature full of wisdom and kindness, whose duty is to protect the flame of life across different eras of history. Explore mysterious lands, solve clever puzzles, and master magical abilities as you engage in an epic battle against the Darkness.

legal_notice:
Trademark Information
"LIGHT REMAINS" is a registered trademark of Triforce Life Solutions SL, serving as the primary brand under which products—including the video game "Little Lights Remain"—are marketed.

This figurative trademark is registered in Spain under Registration No. 4232465/3, covering Classes 09, 16, and 41. The application was filed on September 20, 2023, and officially granted on April 24, 2024, following its publication in the Boletín Oficial de la Propiedad Industrial (B.O.P.I.) on December 4, 2023. The trademark is valid for 10 years, with the option for renewal in successive ten-year periods.

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: i7 or similar.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nvidia 2060 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Protect the spark of Light in a world of looming shadows. Explore, build towers, and solve puzzles to unveil ancient secrets. Every glimmer matters in meticulously crafted, luminous realms, where Darkness lurks with fearsome foes. You are the Guardian—save the universe.
